summary: Iteration 3 verifies P0 mandate: tenant isolation, transaction safety, background worker, and PDF+CSV reports. 48/51 backend tests pass after wallet reseed. All 5 tenant isolation tests pass — cross-tenant reads (parcels/evidence/wallet/notifications/dashboard) are blocked at the SafeCollection layer. Both concurrency tests pass — 10 concurrent /api/parcels against a 25-credit wallet land exactly 5×200 / 5×402, wallet ends at 0 (never negative); idempotency-key replay correctly skips the second deduction. Background worker auto-progresses CONFIDENCE_RECALCULATION from PENDING→COMPLETED within ~10s without any manual /admin/jobs/process call. Legal cross-tenant search returns parcels from other tenants by design. Admin trust/run scans across all tenants (cross-tenant bypass works). Observer dashboard returns aggregate counters. **One critical regression in the user-facing report download endpoints**: both /api/legal/reports/{id}/download AND /api/institution/reports/{id}/download return 404 'Report file missing' because they compute `path = REPORTS_DIR / Path(r['result_url']).name` — and `result_url` is a URL path like '/api/legal/reports/.../download' so `.name` resolves to literal string 'download' instead of the actual PDF filename. The CSV download endpoints work correctly because they use `r['csv_filename']` directly. PDF files (e.g. rep_*.pdf) exist on disk under /app/backend/_reports/ — only the lookup is wrong. The Stripe 404 bug from iteration_2 is fixed (test_stripe_status_unknown_session_returns_404 now PASSES).

critical.issue: Returns 404 'Report file missing' for COMPLETED reports because legal.py line 121 uses `path = REPORTS_DIR / Path(r['result_url']).name`. r['result_url'] is the URL '/api/legal/reports/{id}/download' so `.name` is 'download' (not e.g. 'rep_xxx.pdf'). The Mongo doc carries the correct filename in r['filename']. Fix: `path = REPORTS_DIR / r['filename']` (with a None-guard returning 409 if missing). Same bug exists symmetrically in /api/institution/reports/{report_id}/download (institution.py line 159).

Same root cause as legal: institution.py line 159 uses `path = REPORTS_DIR / Path(r['result_url']).name` → looks up 'download' literal. Fix: `path = REPORTS_DIR / r['filename']`. PDF files are correctly produced by the worker (verified on disk) — only the download lookup is broken.

minor.issue: Job document field is `job_type`, not `type`. Tests/clients that filter by `type` will silently fail to match. Consider aliasing or documenting in OpenAPI.
queue_depth reports total job_queue document count (~1170 historical) rather than PENDING-only depth. This is misleading for ops dashboards. Should filter `{status: 'PENDING'}` or expose both.

Either reseed the demo citizen on backend startup unconditionally, or rewrite the regression test to bootstrap its own citizen. critical_code_review_comments: core/safe_db.SafeCollection auto-injects tenant_id on ALL CRUD ops and falls back to '__NO_TENANT_CONTEXT__' for unauthenticated callers — this is the right default-deny pattern. Verified by 5 isolation tests that cross-tenant reads/writes/listings/notifications/wallets all return 404 or empty as appropriate.

core/tx.run_in_transaction wraps deduct_credits and fulfill_payment with TransientTransactionError auto-retry. Verified end-to-end: 10 concurrent /api/parcels against a 25-credit wallet land EXACTLY 5×200 / 5×402, final balance 0, zero 5xx — proves the conditional `balance>=amount` filter + replica-set TX retries work as designed.

services/worker._claim_one_job uses find_one_and_update for atomic claim — correct pattern, no double-claim possible. CONFIDENCE_RECALCULATION job auto-completes in <10s with empty queue, confirming the startup-hook worker is running.

**Report download endpoints are inconsistent**: CSV uses `r['csv_filename']` (correct) while PDF uses `Path(r['result_url']).name` (incorrect — extracts literal 'download'). The doc-shape mismatch is the root cause. Recommend always reading filenames from explicit fields, never parsing them out of URLs.

test-only routes /api/auth/test-bootstrap-citizen and /api/auth/test-set-balance are unauthenticated; in production these MUST be gated by an env flag (e.g. `ENABLE_TEST_ENDPOINTS=true`) or removed at build time. Otherwise an attacker can mint citizens and credit wallets at will.

Once that ships, re-run `pytest backend/tests/test_worker_reports.py -v` to verify all 6 pass. 2) Before any full-suite run, reseed wallets: `mongosh test_database --eval 'db.credit_wallets.updateMany({},{$set:{balance:250}})'`. 3) Worker test deadline is 150s — the worker batch=5/poll=5s can take ~30-60s when there's queue backlog from prior tests. rca of the issue:
ROOT CAUSE for PDF download 404s: In both /app/backend/routers/legal.py (line 121) and /app/backend/routers/institution.py (line 159), the report download endpoint computes the on-disk path from the URL stored in `r['result_url']`:
```python
path = REPORTS_DIR / Path(r['result_url']).name
```
But `result_url` is the public API URL ('/api/legal/reports/{id}/download'), not the file path. `Path('/api/legal/reports/{id}/download').name` evaluates to the literal string `'download'`. So the code looks for `/app/backend/_reports/download` — which never exists — and returns 404. The actual PDF (e.g. `rep_0f6a67ecf7a34ea2.pdf`) is correctly written to disk by services/jobs.py and the filename is stored in the report doc under `r['filename']`. Note the CSV sibling endpoint uses `r['csv_filename']` directly and works correctly — proof that the data is there. REPRO: as LEGAL user, POST /api/legal/report/{parcel_id} → wait until status=COMPLETED → GET /api/legal/reports/{rid}/download → 404 'Report file missing'. EXPECTED: 200 application/pdf with %PDF header. FIX (one-line per file):
```python
filename = r.get('filename')
if not filename:
    raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail='Report not ready')
path = REPORTS_DIR / filename
```
